signal_text: A Gumroad help center article on file size limits (dated November 20, 2023) states that free products have a 250 MB file size limit, products priced above $0.99 have a 16 GB per-file limit with unlimited file count, and the 'Download all' button is only shown when total content size is less than 500 MB.
subject_exact: Gumroad file size limits by product pricing tier (free: 250MB, paid >$0.99: 16GB per file)
extraction_notes: Two tiers: free products cap at 250MB cumulative; products priced >$0.99 cap at 16GB per single file with unlimited file count. 'Download all' button has separate 500MB threshold. Source November 2023.
